reason: An academic writing toolkit focused on structuring, formatting, checking, and preparing scholarly documents, with README evidence of deterministic, side-effect-free operation.

summaries.zh: 为学术写作提供论文大纲、标题与摘要骨架、引文格式化、表达检查、投稿清单和常用 LaTeX 片段。
summaries.en: Provides academic writing support through paper outlines, title and abstract skeletons, citation formatting, phrasing checks, submission checklists, and common LaTeX snippets.

capabilities: Generates academic writing structures and title or abstract skeletons
Formats citations and reference lists in GB/T 7714, APA 7, and MLA 9
Performs deterministic phrasing checks and pre-submission checklist validation
Generates LaTeX snippets for common academic content
